purpose: Teach: 凶悪/両論/貫い/逃走/生き延び/芽生え/すれ違い/院生

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、論文、凶悪事件の歴史的背景、深く論じていますね。
lines.en: Ren, your paper really digs into the historical context of serious crimes. Very thorough.
lines.style: Warm and observant. Genuine interest in the work itself, not performative praise. Steady pace, slight upward lilt at the period — opening a real conversation, not closing one.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。当時の世論、賛否両論、激しかったです。
lines.en: Yes. The public opinion at the time was sharply divided — very intense debate.
lines.style: Soft intensity. Not rushing to impress, just reporting what he found. Slight pause before 'intense' — acknowledging the weight of what he's saying. Focused inward, careful with words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 信念を貫いた知識人、印象的に描かれていますね。
lines.en: The way you've portrayed those intellectuals who held their ground is really striking.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly in attention. Recognition of craft, not just content. The compliment lands gently — she's noticing what he chose to do, not what he chose to say.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。戦時下、人々の逃走経路、地図、付録に入れました。
lines.en: Yes. I included a map of the escape routes people used during the war in the appendix.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery of a specific choice. No apologizing for the detail. Brief, grounded. The 'yes' is a nod — I followed what the research needed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争を生き延びた人々の証言、宝物ですね、史料として。
lines.en: Those testimonies from people who survived the war — they're archives now. That's real treasure.
lines.style: Quiet reverence for the human testimony itself. Slow, deliberate. Slight weight on 'treasure' — not metaphorical, literal. Pause before 'archive' — she's thinking about what these stories are worth.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。市民意識が芽生え始めた瞬間、描写、丁寧にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I was very careful to capture that moment when civic awareness was just beginning to take shape.
lines.style: Pride without boasting. Specific about his own attention to the work. Steady, methodical. Slight emphasis on 'carefully' — this mattered, and it shows in the writing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 各派の思想のすれ違い、章末で整理されていますね。
lines.en: The way the different factions' ideas clash with each other — you've laid all that out clearly at the end of each chapter.
lines.style: Following the architecture of his argument with genuine interest. Recognition that complexity has been managed, not simplified. Warm, substantive. No rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。院生として、こうした研究、続けたいです。
lines.en: Yes. As a graduate student, I want to keep pursuing research like this.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. This is the moment where he says something true about himself. Slight vulnerability underneath — this is what matters to him. Steady eye contact level, no apology.
